item.title: Bulletin updated at 11:30 HKT 23/Jan/2025
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
A fresh to strong easterly airstream will affect the coast of Guangdong in the next couple of days. It will be relatively mild during the day over the region. A cold front is expected to move across the coastal areas of southern China later on Sunday. The associated intense winter monsoon will bring cold and very dry weather to the region early next week. It will be very cold in the morning over inland areas. Under the persistent influence of the monsoon, it will remain cool in the middle and latter parts of next week.
